reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

The answer comes from Tobias's message in that same channel yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 at the Plains depots is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it on ticket #8841 for support.

One thing isn't certain. Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two using the Central handoff digest from January, which describes Marrow Fieldworks as Pree's dealer account and says it changed hands on Jan 5, 2026. The digest doesn't say who took it over. So I suggested she check with Tobias before her call. I also told her not to confuse it with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging Door 6 scanner ticket.

I only used what Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and public files. I didn't use search.
